sources.independent_laboratory_anchor: Seer, Inc. / Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard
sources.material_context: three source-mapped SPION formulations with published size and zeta-potential records
sources.human_plasma_evidence: Article Methods and source-data audit identify plasma-incubated nanoparticle corona assays.
sources.analysis_role: candidate development source after R3 protocol amendment
limitations: One laboratory only; it cannot establish an independent-laboratory claim by itself.
Raw author intensity values must remain source-specific and cannot be concatenated with the other studies.

sources.independent_laboratory_anchor: Michigan State University-led study with 12 semiquantitative independent proteomics core facilities
sources.material_context: human-plasma protein corona formed on plain polystyrene nanoparticles and sent as identical aliquots to core facilities
sources.analysis_role: primary technical held-out-core benchmark; not a biological-cohort generalization source
limitations: The centres vary LC-MS/MS measurement workflows, not biological cohorts or nanoparticle formulations.
8524 of 29727 replicate source cells are author-marked NA and must be retained as missingness, not imputed at intake.

sources.independent_laboratory_anchor: University of Oklahoma Health Sciences Center
sources.material_context: gold-nanoparticle corona experiments in human plasma and enriched low-abundance plasma
sources.analysis_role: candidate external rank-only source after row-level mapping
limitations: The available tables are source-reported identified-protein lists and aggregate spectral-count columns; absence of a row cannot be converted into a non-detection label.
No cross-study abundance scale may be inferred from its spectral counts.
